module: Flowgraph node "Rally Mode Track Recovery" (category repeat_instant, tag rally). Tracks flips and recoveries: every frame, computes recoveryType among 'flip', 'recovery', 'restart' (the last active pin wins) and calls extensions.hook('onRallyVehicleRecovery', recoveryType). Flow inputs: flip, recovery, restart.
notes: The hook is called every frame, including with recoveryType = nil when no pin is active.
The description of the restart pin is "A recovery" (copy-paste).

work.desc: Determines the recovery type and emits the onRallyVehicleRecovery hook.
